notes.title: August Update
notes.content: [p]Update content:[/p][p]1: The game battle interface has been redistributed, with the addition of a real-time panel that tracks the damage and percentage output of each character in the battle interface[/p][p]2: Optimized translation[/p][p]3: Fixed some bugs in the previous version[/p]

notes.title: This game is scheduled for a small update on July 25th
notes.content: [p][/p][p]This game is scheduled for a small update on July 25th[/p][p][/p][p]Update content:[/p][p]1: Optimize translation[/p][p]2: New difficulty selection system[/p][p]3: Adjust some professions[/p][p]4: Add more types of equipment in the later stage[/p][p]5: Optimization and Remake of Farm and Ranch Gameplay[/p][p]6: Fix known bugs at this stage[/p][p]7: Make some optimizations based on player suggestions and recommendations[/p][p][/p][p]Currently known bugs:[/p][p]The UI for soul beads and coins sometimes does not display, and will only refresh after a battle (without affecting the game progress)[/p][p]The mission to save the Sea Tree Village may not be able to exit the map and can only use teleportation scrolls (players who are not aware of this bug should prepare teleportation scrolls at any location to avoid being unable to exit during the mission to save the Sea Tree Village)[/p][p]I apologize for the above bugs, and I will try my best to ensure that there are no bugs in future versions![/p][p]Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience![/p]

notes.title: July's major update
notes.content:
1: Open up all profession choices, now players will no longer have to choose a fixed number of professions in the tavern, but can choose their teammates from all professions!
2: Expand the player's team size to 8 people (if needed)
3: Optimization of prompts for obtaining and losing items
4: The store has now been changed to allow players to rest at any time and stay overnight, and players can choose for themselves
5: Adjusted the translation issue for the task!
Because this update has changed the save structure of teammates, if you use the old save, there may be bugs on teammates' equipment
So I don't recommend using old save files for gaming, this is a technical issue, and I sincerely apologize here!
To compensate for the inconvenience of inheriting old archives, all new archives now receive a demon stone chest and puncher as rewards at the beginning!
Thank you all for your appreciation. As I independently created the entire game, if there are any areas that have not been changed, it will be a matter of my time. I will make up for them in future updates!
I will also promise to maintain a monthly update status and ensure that future updates will not affect the archive again!
For foreign friends, as English is not my native language, there are a large number of translation issues that have been overlooked. I will gradually fix them completely in the upcoming updates!

notes.title: July Small and Medium sized Update Announcement!
notes.content: [p]Dragons and Elves are preparing for a small to medium-sized update on July 1st, mainly based on recent player feedback[/p][p]The updated content is as follows:[/p][p]All professions can be recruited, and players do not have to choose a fixed few professions in the tavern. Moreover, they can freely choose from 30 professions each time[/p][p]And the player's team size has expanded to a maximum of 8 people[/p][p]Replace and iterate some of the maps in the game, striving to become more beautiful and vivid![/p][p]Add items in the game that can both avoid encountering enemies and increase the probability of encountering them[/p][p]Hotels can choose to take breaks: rest for a while or stay overnight, both will restore your state of mind![/p][p]Fix some minor issues and unreasonable places[/p][p]The possible updates are as follows:[/p][p]AFK system[/p][p]Reminder: Because this update has changed the structure of the archive, the old archive is not compatible after the update! I'm very sorry, this was my technical mistake. I sincerely apologize to everyone and will add new saved initial props as compensation in the new version![/p][p]You can familiarize yourself with the game first and restart after the update on July 1st![/p][p]I promise that in future updates, there will be no need to reopen the archive again![/p]

notes.title: Latest patch
notes.content:
Based on player feedback, make the following adjustments:
After upgrading, the state can be restored
You can stay at the hotel anytime without waiting until night!
Reduced the difficulty in the early and middle stages of the game!
Sincere thanks to everyone for their support!
